WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, fulfilment_type, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order
)
SELECT wd.dd, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_rl,
  count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS orders, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS minload, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS maxload,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS testlines, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<>900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non900
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE wd.dd BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, o.status, o.fulfilment_type, (o.web_order_id IS NULL) AS no_order,
  count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS orders, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date) AS mind, max(f.sale_date) AS maxd,
  sum(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nodisp
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-10' AND DATE '2025-12-26'
  AND (s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL OR f.channel_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.category='ZZ Test' AS test, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) AS dist_n, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24' AND s.store_id IN (900,999)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 0 AS ref
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net, 1
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT n.business_date, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS web_net_sales, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ref=0 THEN net_sales END),2) AS before_returns,
  (SELECT net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.store_id=900 AND r.business_date=n.business_date) AS rpt_net,
  (SELECT net_sales_before_returns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.store_id=900 AND r.business_date=n.business_date) AS rpt_before,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order x WHERE x.web_order_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_orders
FROM net_lines n
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (SELECT receipt_id, count(*) AS n, sum(gross_amount) AS g FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd, o.status,
  count(*) AS orders, sum(CASE WHEN l.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.n<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linecount_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(l.g-o.order_total_gross)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <> CAST(o.dispatch_ts_utc AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tz_shift
FROM fact_web_order o LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.dispatch_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-14 12:00:00' AND o.dispatch_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-24 12:00:00'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
